general_information.Description: -Objective: Upon the rapid growth of the meeting, expositions, events and conventions industry (MEEC), the subject is aimed to provide an introduction to the MEEC industry -Description: It gives a comprehensive overview of the burgeoning field of planning and producing MEEC — meetings, expositions, events, and conventions with the study of varied segments of the field, along with discussions of new trends. -Teaching method: lecturing in combination with case study analysis, MEEC practice -Assessment scheme: small seminar organisation, midterm test, final report
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: -Objective: Upon the rapid growth of the meeting, expositions, events and conventions industry (MEEC), the subject is aimed to provide an introduction to the MEEC industry -Description: It gives a comprehensive overview of the burgeoning field of planning and producing MEEC — meetings, expositions, events, and conventions with the study of varied segments of the field, along with discussions of new trends. -Teaching method: lecturing in combination with case study analysis, MEEC practice -Assessment scheme: small seminar organisation, midterm test, final report

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choices and short answer questions
Seminar organising and Vietnam cases presentation
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Specialized aspects of studied topics '- small MEEC organising practice
assessments.Grading Guide: - Guided by instructor during the first lecture - Students working in a team to be in charge of organising a seminar on the topic of the chapter learnt for the class - The agenda of the seminar will include theory review, cases in Vietnam and discusion - The organisers have to act with different roles: presenters, MC, discussion moderators, conference staff... to deliver the session
assessments.Note: The marking will be based on the understanding of the theory (theory review), ability to apply, analyse and evaluate (case presentation and discussion leading), and skills of organisation, critical thinking and creativity (the actual seminar organisation) Team-based

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Final report will cover all chapters
assessments.Grading Guide: The students have to choose a real MEEC in Vietnam. They have to use different methods to collect the data and base on the knowledge of the subject to evaluate the organisation process of the event. Then, the team will write a plan for the next event
